ocl.definition: term:LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(t | t.ItemID = itemid and t.Content = content)
ocl.postcondition: if term.oclIsUndefined() then let newTerm:LoanTerm in newTerm.oclIsNew() and LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(newTerm) and newTerm.ItemID = itemid and newTerm.Content = content and result = true else result = false endif
